fact: On 22 October 2026 the Justice Minister said many people have been brought to court or are held at Makala prison for digital-space offences, that two trials were held at Makala, and that the number of cases brought to court is assessed each week; no figures are given.
title: RDC : Des personnes poursuivies pour des infractions numériques détenues à Makala, annonce Guillaume Ngefa
